snippet.title: Rayman Forever gameplay (PC Game, 1998)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Rayman Forever (aka rayman gold), Dos PC game produced by UBI Soft in 1998 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/rayman-forever/14437/
Playing this republished version of the first original Rayman, just a few stages to show how the game works.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
